entries.what: Jun works the Monday shift at Heron & Grind; Linh is cramming for midterms at the vault wall. He spends the slow stretch writing a better closing checklist so the new 9 p.m. night crew isn't stuck with his messes.
entries.outcome: Checklist taped inside the back-office cabinet; Beatrice approves it.

entries.what: After the shift he stops by Ruiz Family Market for wrapper cases and compares prices on shrimp.
entries.outcome: Buys two cases and keeps the receipt for Linh's sheet.

entries.what: Back at the sublet with boxes packed, he talks with Tess about the leftover kitchen gear he's taking and the onion verdict on the latest batch.
entries.outcome: Tess lets him keep the stockpots.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind during midterm week, with students packing the cafe until 9. He uses the new checklist to wrap up.
Late dinner of al pastor at Taquería Colima on the way home.
Day off for Tess, so Jun has coffee at her place and helps her sort the coworker lumpia order list on the fridge.
entries.outcome: Tallies orders for the coming weekend.

entries.what: Afternoon cafe shift pouring tulip-rosettas for the study crowd; he shows Linh a trick for foam.
Evening at the fourplex sorting receipts and updating Linh's sheet on his phone, which dies by 4 p.m. again.
Closing shift; the nurses union vote is the talk of the cafe as tired St. Anselm staff come in for coffee.
Texts Paolo to confirm prep for Friday's commissary block; Paolo says he'll try to make it after his line shift.
Fills up the hatchback at the Ruel Road station before heading home.
entries.outcome: Tank full, cheaper than the ramp.

entries.what: Opening shift is a day off from closers, so he preps for the commissary; Friday evening he arrives at the Ruel Road kitchen for his standing 5-9 block, but Paolo is stuck at his line job.
Rolls 200 lumpia alone, scrubs the fryer area to dodge Joan's $40 fee and cleans up by the end of the block.
At midnight at the fourplex, he asks the assistant for hand-stretch tips for his cramping wrists.
Saturday table at Heron & Grind; Wes buys two lumpia in quarters, and customers ask about the Sunday market.
Opens a business checking account at a credit union and sets up a card reader on his phone, replacing cash only plus personal app.
entries.outcome: Card reader works on a test charge.

entries.what: Evening he tells Linh about the reader and thanks her for the sheet over a ristretto.
entries.outcome: Plans to link sales tab to reader totals.

entries.what: Sunday morning he drafts the profit split proposal for Paolo, softens nothing, and asks the assistant to tighten it, keeping the firm version.
entries.outcome: Proposal 70/30 Jun/Paolo with Paolo keeping Instagram and market setup.

entries.what: Meets Paolo at the fourplex to talk through the new split.
Evening he texts Tess a photo of the sold-out batch and waits for her verdict.
